duration.H1_full_mature_population: Not reconstructable from H3-mature prediction rows; separate root label-identity inventory required.
duration.note: H1 uses the same fixed H3 scores and masks, no H1 fit. H1 residual D1 subtracts the fixed H3 baseline score; paired D1 differences cancel that baseline. Delta target is not a separately fitted forecast.

holding.rule: Actual filled entry/maturity intervals form inclusive overlap components; unfilled zero-return attempts are separate units. Cluster weights=1/cluster size; within-group D1 denominators recomputed. Chronological actual-interval dedup is retrospective, not a tradable schedule or frequency claim.

D1.description: Each year removes three largest signed contributions for this statistic, then all denominators are recomputed; diagnostic only.

D2.description: Each year removes three largest signed contributions for this statistic, then all denominators are recomputed; diagnostic only.

20.method: Nonoverlapping calendar blocks, sampled with replacement separately within each year; the short final block is a block. Number of blocks sampled per year equals observed blocks. Empty days retained; group and parent denominators recomputed. Ordinary percentile95 uses available statistic replicates; simultaneous Bonferroni percentile intervals use joint-valid replicates at1.25/98.75 percentiles (97.5% marginal each). No refits, training uncertainty or selection adjustment.

full_period_raw.note: Full-period parent opportunities with valid methanol and mature H3 labels; 2020-2022 are raw descriptions only. H1 independent full-maturity inventory is delivered separately by root; this file alone cannot reconstruct H1-only signals.

limits: All previously seen development data; component labels are overlapping attempts, not investable account returns.
Intervals condition on supplied fitted scores, not training uncertainty; Bonferroni bootstrap intervals do not correct historical model/feature selection.
D1 is conditional association with the fixed baseline, not a causal commodity effect.
D2 recomputes allocation per all parent opportunities, including unfilled zero returns and unselected opportunities.
Realised-interval clustering and chronological dedup use future exits for diagnosis only, never a deployable scheduling or frequency claim.
